name: data-store
description: GitHub Actions for caching and restoring git-fit data sources (L1 raw / L2 std).

scripts.build: esbuild src/restore.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=cache/restore/dist/index.js && esbuild src/save.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=cache/save/dist/index.js && esbuild src/shared.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/shared.cjs
scripts.build:check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- cache/restore/dist cache/save/dist dist/shared.cjs
